entities.summary: Vitali Davidovich Milman is a mathematician specializing in analysis. He is a professor at the Tel Aviv University. In the past he was a President of the Israel Mathematical Union and a member of the “Aliyah” committee of Tel Aviv University. He is the recipient of the 2024 Israel Prize in the field of mathematics and computer science. Vitali Milman was a logicians & mathematicians from Odesa (b. 1939-08-22, Odesa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
